1. A knower’s belief must be produced or sustained by a mechanism that is reliable in an appropriate sense.
2. If X must be produced or sustained by a mechanism that is reliable in an appropriate sense, then X requires a mechanism that produces true beliefs in actual situations and would produce true beliefs or at least inhibit false beliefs in relevant counterfactual situations.
3. Therefore, A knower’s belief requires a mechanism that produces true beliefs in actual situations and would produce true beliefs or at least inhibit false beliefs in relevant counterfactual situations. [1,2]
